name: Create a multi-character animated episode
description: Verifies a story with selected characters creates scenes with independently choreographed character actions.
expected: The storyboard appears and characters visibly move independently over the scene, including walk/run/talk/smile or meet actions.

name: Preview voices and audio controls
description: Verifies the generated episode exposes voice preview and audio controls.
steps: Toggle background music and sound effects
expected: The selected device voice previews the current shot and the music and sound-effect controls visibly change state.

name: Export independently animated characters
description: Verifies character-layer animation is rendered into the downloadable WebM with audio.
steps: Enable background music and sound effects
expected: A WebM episode is rendered and downloaded with the moving character layers and audio effects.

name: Reuse and select custom characters
description: Verifies custom characters remain available and can be selected for another episode.
steps: Create an episode using the selected cast
expected: The selected characters remain in the Cast panel and the generated episode assigns actions to them.

name: Reject missing story or cast
description: Verifies the app blocks episode generation when required story or cast data is missing.
expected: A clear validation message is shown and no episode is created.
